column2:
Golden Bough Hunt
A wild land of ancient strata, said to be where
Elmenas, the school of sages, first began.
Over long ages, strange rocks with an eerie air about
them have become a natural work of art.

Campnero
A valley village wrapped in the deep, deep green that
fairies love.
In recent years it has produced fine little folk, such as
Papesh Fake, Head of Keys, and Regios Pandoretta
the Shuffler.
Not seeking glory, they simply found themselves
called sages one day...
The plain spirit of Elmenas's earliest days still lives on
in this land, embraced by nature.

Stargazing Canopy
The foremost altar of Elmenas, said to have ended the
long War of the Black Rose three hundred years ago.
It is a catalyst for magic, binding layer upon layer of
magic circles to the courses of the stars.
Mossy though it is, it is said to watch over all the
school's lands even now.

The Watchtower
The great Tower of Iria, guardian of the west of
Elmenas.
It was an endless seat of learning, setting down every
event in the world in words.
Not three years have passed since Paladine, the Hall
of Wisdom and one of the Four Great Schools, took it
as its home, yet it stands proud in beauty and
strength as a castle guarding the school.

Central Schoolhouse
The heart of Elmenas, Academy of the East, and a vast
building where every student can gather at once.
Built upon layer after layer of ancient ruins, the
Central Schoolhouse, the Royal Cente, fell to the
Crawlers in a mere three days.
Now a heap of rubble steeped in Chaos, what does
this symbol of the school dwell on, as it lays its ruin
bare...?

Forest of Wandering
One of the natural strongholds guarding Elmenas.
Its rugged, tangled land and countless giant trees
have long made it a fortress of nature.
Its soil brims with water, and its lush evergreens keep
fire at bay as they mark the ages.

Amanjio Battlefield
A scenic spot once counted among the Three Views of
Elmenas.
At the end of the War of the Black Rose, when the
fighting spread to the heart of Elmenas, it became the
field of the final battle.
And so it is now a barren land, where it is hard even to
imagine how it once looked.

Inner Sea
A rich sea of vivid ultramarine at the centre of
Elmenas.
The only sea road to the Central Schoolhouse passes
the Unmoving Bridge and runs out to the open ocean
in the west.
Sages with a hand for ships are said to favour the
swift sea road.

Payan
The school's gateway by sea.
Twelve bird-calling lighthouses cling to the sheer
cliffs, watching over voyages.
Those who become Head of Wings receive their name
in this land.
It is proof of peerless seamanship...
and at the same time the name of a great power that
calls the winds to welcome friends safely home and
send them off again.

Razenis Strait
The sea road's checkpoint, leading to the Unmoving
Bridge.
In early spring, when snowmelt pours into the Inner
Sea, it becomes a waterfall that could swallow a great
sailing ship whole, a sight of real power.
Even outside the season of falls, the currents churn
with the water level and temperature, a peril that
makes even seasoned sailors tense.
It is an unwritten rule in Elmenas to make the
Unmoving Bridge your last port of call.

Unmoving Bridge
The great Galahanov Bridge, long famed as the key to
the sea road into Elmenas, spans the strait in a single
stride.
The splendid stonework of the Twilight Dwarves has
been added to for four hundred years, until the strait
itself became a vast fortress.
Even now, a stone-carving feast lasting ten days and
nights is held as a sign of the calm seas.
Gospel Brass, one of the Four, makes its home here,
and the hardy heavy warriors who gather there walk
each day among the legacy of the past; perhaps that
is why they grow to hold righteousness and true
resolve above all.

Hall of Contemplation
The northern sanctuary of St. Sevies, highest of the
glorious Four of Elmenas.
For its wealth and the hidden legacy of its past, the
school has long suffered secret attempts at
occupation, great and small.
The history of the light-filled Hall of Contemplation is
also a dark history of crushing every heartless
invasion.

Baleos Wasteland
The great wasteland where Diploma, the two-headed
dragon who ruled thunder and storm, sleeps.
The wind spirits who mourned its death still rage
across it as fierce storms of sand.

Storm Hill
A path for gusts born of the Inner Sea's cold air and
the warm air inland.
The children's game of sending words to faraway
friends on this wind never dies out.

Sea God's Shrine
The centre of the faith that keeps the Inner Sea at
peace.
The Inner Sea links to countless lakes through
underground waters.
The faith is said to have begun when people,
believing the sea god's wrath made fearful cries,
prayed to calm it.
Now, instead, people mostly read omens from how
those strange sounds are heard.

The Pale Fortress
One of the castles of the Four.
Badly weakened in the battle of the Royal Cente, the
Shield of Purity suspended its castle for a time and
fell back to Elberois.
In time, its beautiful white form shining on the lake
gave it the name Endymion.
It is the key to the east of Elmenas, marked by its long
bridges running north and south.

Scales Cave
A holy place revered by those who live by trade and
negotiation.
Batra Fedrinsk, Head of Scales, is also high priest of
this cave.

Old Imperial Library
It was first built in Super Nymphens, the imperial
capital that came before Elmenas.
Its collection is unmatched, and it is said that rare
books now wait in deep darkness for the day they are
opened.

Saints' Tomb
Where the sages called Heads through the ages rest,
numbered among the saints.
Flowers are never lacking at their graves, and from
them one can glimpse who they were in life.
It is said that the many things the saints carried from
birth to death are given, little by little, to those who
visit.

Daleos Undercity
Daleos, where a wealth of breathtaking carvings
sleeps.
Rooted deep underground, it lies unseen across a vast
stretch of land.
It was once used for lessons in dungeon exploring,
but its role now ended, it is said to pass quiet days.

Keneone Forest
A deep forest where dark shadows fall even at
midday.
Here you will learn how small you truly are.
Yet its many hidden dangers may be the tension no
adventurer can do without.

Elberois
Birthplace of Innocentia, the Shield of Purity, and the
home where its founder, Denehere Ruverdracloa, was
born and raised.
After the School entered the Pale Fortress, Endymion,
as one of the Four, it became a villa for strolls and
rest.

Chaos crawled into the Royal Cente and brought it
down from within, and the threat reached even the
castles of the Four.
Scattered by what is now called the retreat from the
Royal Cente, the Shield of Purity chose to leave its
great castle.
It took refuge in Elberois, far from the heart of
Elmenas, and chose to gather its strength.

Hermes Plain
Small animals hide in grassland as far as the eye can
see.
Here people learn anew what the bonds of family, in
all their shapes, mean.
And they will see, too, realities there that are all too
cruel.
Which is exactly why a glimpse of something sweet
can soften the heart.

Sera's Water-Weave
Sera, a land of lakes and marshes large and small.
It hosts many lessons, from playing in the river to
fishing, net-casting, boating and marching by
waterway.
Among the children, it is surely one of the most
popular lesson spots.

Darowana Marsh
A sanctuary of birds where the rich web of life and
clear spirit power are all a lesson.
Calling pebbles by name, spinning the names of trees
long fallen, seeking spirit words in the babbling
stream...
It is said that sensitive children gain something there
that adults cannot feel.

Starfall Hill
Stars twinkling so near you could touch them with an
outstretched hand...
Looking up at that night, perhaps the children learn
the awe of darkness and the frailty of light.
Since olden days, classes have never stopped visiting
this land as part of their lessons.
